verdict: Leads surged this week, but none are reaching your pipeline yet.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 86 leads from Meta at an average cost of $20.88 per lead — a 36% improvement in efficiency compared to your own prior baseline, driven by the August Re-Launch campaign ramping up. The concern right now is not the ads: your CRM shows 68 contacts logged, zero opportunities created, and zero appointments booked, meaning leads are arriving but not moving toward cases. This is an intake and automation gap, not an advertising problem. SMS follow-up automation and phone access setup are being prioritized now to close that gap before more leads go untouched. Once those are live — targeted for by end of September — you'll have a clearer picture of how many of these leads are converting to actual cases.
